## Cross Product
Take the cross of two vectors to find the one perpendicular to both.

I know this sounds useless in 2D, but trust me it's still handy!

$$\vec{A} \times \vec{B} = 
\begin{pmatrix}
A_yB_z - A_zB_y\\
A_zB_x - A_xB_z \\
A_xB_y - A_yB_x
\end{pmatrix}$$

. . . 

I actually memorize that by taking the determinant of this matrix (where $i, j, k$ point along $x, y, z$)

$$\vec{A} \times \vec{B} = \text{det}\begin{pmatrix}
i & j & k\\
A_x & A_y & A_z\\
B_x & B_y & B_z 
\end{pmatrix}$$
